standing_order: Find the level exit alive; fight what blocks the way; pick up supplies when they are needed.

steer.question: Which way now? The map's route goes {route_where}. Space ahead: {ahead}, left: {left}, right: {right}, behind: {behind}. Stuck: {stuck}.

criteria.Follow route: Stuck is no and the space in the route's direction is clear or tight: keep following the route.
criteria.Left: The route's way is blocked or stuck is yes, and space left is clear or unknown (not blocked): turn left and go look that way.
criteria.Right: The route's way is blocked or stuck is yes, left is blocked, and space right is clear or unknown: turn right and go look that way.
criteria.Back: The route's way is blocked or stuck is yes, both sides are blocked, and space behind is clear or unknown: back out.
criteria.Turn around: Blocked or stuck and every side is blocked: turn around and look.

dodge.question: Sidestep away from an enemy? Threat: {threat} ({enemy_where}). Space left: {left}, right: {right}, behind: {behind}.

criteria.Carry on: Threat is safe. Do not dodge just because an enemy exists.
criteria.Dodge left: Threat is danger and space left is clear.
criteria.Dodge right: Threat is danger, left is not clear, space right is clear.
criteria.Dodge back: Threat is danger, sides not clear, space behind is clear.

move.question: Advance now? Route aligned ahead: {aligned}. Space ahead: {ahead}. Stuck: {stuck}. Space behind: {behind}. Navigator: {mode}.

criteria.Forward: Route aligned ahead is yes and space ahead is clear or tight. Also forward to close on a distant enemy, and forward when at a door (walk up to it while it opens).
criteria.Hold: Route aligned ahead is no (turn first), or space ahead is blocked and not at a door, or the destination is here, or stuck with nothing known clear around (turn instead).
criteria.Backward: Stuck is yes and space behind is clear.

strafe.question: Recovery sidestep? Stuck: yes. Space left: {left}, right: {right}.

criteria.Hold: Neither side is known clear: turn instead.
criteria.Strafe right: Left is blocked, space right is clear.

turn.question: Turn to put {aim_target} in the crosshair. It is now: {aim}.

criteria.Fine left: It is slightly left or just left of the crosshair.
criteria.Fine right: It is slightly right or just right of the crosshair.

fire.question: Pull the trigger? Living enemy in the crosshair: {in_crosshair} ({enemy_where}). Equipped ammunition: {equipped_ammo}. Never shoot at the route waypoint.

criteria.Fire: Enemy in the crosshair is yes and equipped ammunition is more than zero.
criteria.Hold fire: Enemy in the crosshair is no, or equipped ammunition is zero.

weapon.question: Which weapon? Equipped: {equipped}. Shotgun shells: {shells}. Pistol bullets: {bullets}. Owns shotgun: {owns_shotgun}.

criteria.Keep: The equipped weapon still has ammunition.
criteria.Pistol: Shotgun shells are zero and pistol bullets remain.
criteria.Shotgun: Owns a shotgun with shells and the pistol is equipped.

use.question: Press use (open a door, flip a switch, try a wall)? Navigator: {mode}. Route blocked at arm length: {blocked_route}. Stuck: {stuck}.

criteria.Use: Route blocked at arm length is yes, or stuck is yes, or the navigator is at a door, at the exit line, or trying walls: press it.

goal.question: Immediate priority? Level {level}. Health: {health}. Threat: {threat} ({enemy_where}). Ammunition: {ammo}. Armor: {armor}. Nearby pickups: health {health_pickup}, ammo {ammo_pickup}, armor {armor_pickup}. Unexplored frontiers: {frontiers}. Navigator: {mode}.

criteria.Kill enemies: An enemy is visible at close or mid range, health is not critical and ammunition is ready.
criteria.Restore health: Health is critical, or low with a health pickup seen and no close enemy.
criteria.Stock ammo: Ammunition is empty or scarce and an ammo pickup was seen.
criteria.Add armor: Armor is none, an armor pickup was seen close by (small dest_dist), health fine, no close enemy. If the armor sits far off or across unclear terrain, keep exploring instead of chasing it.
criteria.Explore: No close enemy, health fine, ammunition ready: keep exploring toward the nearest frontier to find the exit. Also Explore whenever the navigator is at a door, fetching a key, heading for the exit or trying walls: let it finish.
criteria.Scout: The nearest frontier is exhausted or the player keeps getting stuck: head for a far unexplored part of the map.
criteria.Upgrade weapon: No shotgun owned, a weapon was seen, no close enemy.
